November 5, 2019 
 
Ms. Bonnie Tang 
Life and Health Actuarial Office 
Texas Department of Insurance 
P.O. Box 14904 
Austin, TX 78714-9104 
 
   Re:   Southern Farm Bureau Life Insurance Company 
 Long Term Care Insurance Policy: 3034, 3034Q, 3035, 3035Q 
FILE LOG NUMBER: FID SFBL-131934914 
  
Dear Ms. Tang,  
 
This letter is in response to your letter to Sarah Lee dated October 22, 2019.  The letter 
indicated that further information is needed regarding the above -captioned filing.  
Specifically, you noted the following: 
 
1. Regarding section 10 of your Actuarial Memorandum, please provide the “Average 
Annual Premium – Premium Paying Policies” after proposed rate increase. 
 
Please see the table below for the requested information. 
 
  
 
 
 
2. Regarding item 11 of your 9/4 response, you stated that “The current rate increase 
filing uses historical experience through 2018 in conjunction with the 2000 -2011 
Society of Actuaries Long Term Care Intercompany Study.” Please provide numerical 
demonstration to explain the difference, including selection factors, improvement, etc. 
Also, what the experience year does the company’s most current GPV morbidity 
assumption include? 
 
No morbidity or mortality improvement is assumed in this filing.  Exhibit IV in the 
original submission contains information regarding the selection factors that were 
applied to the Intercompany Study.  Please see the attached Exhibit II for a numerical 
demonstration of future incurred claims with and without selection factors applied 
to the Intercompany Study results.  The selection factors increase the PV of incurred 
claims by 26%.
